heroTitle:
A song of faith.
A heart of worship.
heroDescription: Christian music rooted in the hope of Jesus. A place to pause, listen, and lift your heart toward Him.
aboutTitle:
Faith at the center.
Music from the heart.
aboutText: Welcome to Austin Westphal Music. This is a space for music that points to Jesus — through seasons of joy, moments of uncertainty, and the everyday journey of faith.
aboutSecondParagraph: My prayer is that every song becomes an invitation to draw closer to God and remember the hope we have in Him. Thank you for being part of the journey.
